[b][u][i]Wessernian Government Document 985: Blue Dove Peace Keeper Donation
Date: September 26, 2025[/b][/u][/i]

Reason for Donation: To provide the Blue Dove Peace Keepers (BD for easier documental use) with supplies.
Donated Supplies:
[list][*]5,000 barrels of oil: Extracted at a cost of approximately ₩50,000 and valued at ₩310,000. It is recommended for use in Wessernian vehicles, as its chemical composition is optimized for Wessernian systems.
[*]10,000 pounds of medical equipment: Estimated value of ₩995 million. The equipment consists of 5,000 Individual First Aid Kits (IFAKs) and 5,000 units of Class II and Class III equipment.
[*]1,000 Wessernian vehicles: Consisting of 10 ships (2 destroyers, 3 cruisers, and 5 supply ships), 520 tanks and other armored vehicles (including 20 torpedo boats and duck boats), and 70 planes (bombers and fighters). The original construction cost was ₩23 billion, but this is considered irrelevant due to the age of the equipment. A cost of ₩2.5 billion was incurred to maintain readiness for donation or modification. These vehicles, which were built between the 1970s and 1980s, are recommended to be filled with Wessernian oil for optimal performance. Manuals for maintenance and blueprints for manufacturing are also included.
[*]50,000 pounds of ammunition: Original cost was ₩300 million, but this is irrelevant as it was originally intended for the Wessernian military. Blueprints for manufacturing are also provided.
[*]3,000 guns: Manufactured at a cost of ₩680,000. These guns can be easily modified for various ammunition types, but they function best with Wessernian ammunition. Blueprints are included. The donation comprises an assortment of weapon types, including assault rifles, pistols, and machine guns.
[*]₩1 million: Donated to the BD.
[*]10 trained professionals: Volunteers whose contracts end within the year. They will provide training to BD mechanics on vehicle maintenance and related skills, as well as be trained for more standard BD vehicles.

Additional Notes:
All equipment, except for the medical supplies and ammunition, is from the 70s and 80s and has never been used. Also The guns have been modified to use newer ammunition.
This donation is the largest made by the Wessernian government to the BD, and, as ruled by the Main Council of 13 and the Lower Council of 29, a donation of this magnitude will not be repeated.

[b]Emperor Piter Drømm I, December 2026[/b]
Three months had passed since the start of the Constitutional Council, and things were looking up for Thýven as a new imperial government began to form, based around a series of heavy checks and balances on the powers of the government. Several agreements had been made in the three months to permit the continuation of the Imperial Identity that had been forged by Erjk Drs, merely to allow continuity of state. However, it was decided by the convention that no member of the former royal family could take the throne again unless explicitly voted upon by a plebiscite. Thus in October they began the search for a new emperor. Several candidates came forward, the Alexandrii-Claudii, the Ptolenoi, and various other North Thýven houses were considered but eventually passed over due to perceived elitism. It was clear that the people would not accept a noble-born emperor once more, so they turned to the ranks of the convention, moving quickly to enquire of Piter Drømm, who was widely liked by the populace for acting as a mediator between them and the council. While Piter Drømm initially rejected the idea of taking on the imperial mantle, once word had gotten out that he was being considered, a mob formed outside of the Palace of the Legislature to force him to take the mantle.

Thus on December 12, 2026, a rainy and wet day, Emperor Piter Drømm was acclaimed by the council on the balcony of the royal palace of Erjk I, with a large crowd below him chanting nationalist slogans. Piter struck a modest figure on the balcony, clothed in only a suit and tie he readied to position himself as The Populist Emperor, refusing royal regalia beyond only the titles. 

Thus the Holy Orthodox Empire of Thýven was declared from the balcony by its new emperor, a simple, boring stag, with no family lineage, no formal background beyond law school and service in the legislature, and a peach farm, he was perhaps the plainest of rulers.
